crossRefs.note: The child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses, and said…
When he was thrown out, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.

people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt
